body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. Yourself or one adjacent willing ally gains +1 Composure against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The protected creature may move 1 unit toward you; self moves freely.
Suppress one ordinary Success Die penalty on that creature's next Combat Card until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Ancestor
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Ancestor Full Manifestation (FM-2A). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
